tools.name: ask
tools.description: Natural-language search (NLWeb /ask) over Agent Ready's own content — scoring methodology, the check registry, the specs it validates, and the content library (explainers, comparisons, how-to guides, glossary). Returns Schema.org-typed results. Optional itemType narrows the corpus; mode 'summarize' adds an extractive summary.

itemType.description: Narrow the search to one corpus type (default: any).

mode.description: list (default) or summarize for an extractive summary.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Fetch a previously run Agent Ready scan by its id (shareToken) and return the score summary. Use to re-read a result or poll a scan that was still running.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Scan a public website for AI agent-readability against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, llmstxt.org, and agent-protocol manifests. Returns a 0–100 score, the llms.txt score, and the top failing checks with a link to the full per-check report.

url.description: The public URL to scan, e.g. https://example.com
